    /**
     * The nearest of [actors] to [from], other than it, of the Actor type called [name] or one inheriting from it, that no
     * Block has removed, or null if there is none, for the Blocks moving towards a type an Actor type reference
     * Property names.
     */
    fun nearestActiveOf(actors: List<Actor>, name: String, from: com.pandulapeter.kubriko.actor.traits.Positionable): com.pandulapeter.kubriko.actor.traits.Positionable? {
        val type = typeIndexOf(name)
        if (type < 0) return null
        var nearest: com.pandulapeter.kubriko.actor.traits.Positionable? = null
        var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
        for (index in actors.indices) {
            val candidate = actors[index]
            if (candidate === from || candidate !is com.pandulapeter.kubriko.actor.traits.Positionable || !isActiveOf(candidate, type)) continue
            val offset = candidate.body.position - from.body.position
            val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
            if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                nearest = candidate
                nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
            }
        }
        return nearest
    }

    /**
     * The distance from [from] to the Actor [nearestActiveOf] finds, between their positions, or Float.MAX_VALUE if there
     * is none, for the conditions measuring it.
     */
    fun distanceToNearestOf(actors: List<Actor>, name: String, from: com.pandulapeter.kubriko.actor.traits.Positionable): Float {
        val nearest = nearestActiveOf(actors, name, from) ?: return Float.MAX_VALUE
        val offset = nearest.body.position - from.body.position
        return kotlin.math.sqrt(offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw)
    }

        "EveryChild" -> 1
        "EveryGrandchild" -> 2
        "EveryParent" -> 3
        else -> -1

    private fun isActiveOf(actor: Actor, type: Int): Boolean = when (type) {
        0 -> actor is EveryBlock && !actor.isRemoved
        1 -> actor is EveryChildBase && !actor.isRemoved
        2 -> actor is EveryGrandchild && !actor.isRemoved
        3 -> actor is EveryParentBase && !actor.isRemoved
